title: Corrected user-confirmed direction
observation: Hybrid visual-first, code-first and mixed authoring; private Payload; ministry-controlled custom repository; ordinary content work independent of GitHub.
limits: Detailed technical choices remain proposed; earlier support-oriented review is withdrawn.

title: Current develop branch
observation: Observed head 7abd2c11ffd4ed70c6775c4fd6f51c996e4350dd.
limits: Source inspection is not a runtime or production verification.

title: Admin package manifest
observation: Payload 4.0.0-internal.1f9ae9a; Next 16.3.0-preview.9; React 19.2.3; TypeScript 6.0.3.
limits: Pinned does not mean supported or qualified. No lockfile install was performed in this review.

title: Native document editor
observation: The current editor imports Payload form, preview, and save/publish components.
limits: Only the relevant source section was inspected; this is not proof of independent CMS frontend parity.

title: Phase 23 PR 1340
observation: Open and unmerged when checked; describes D1–D36 and existing owner seams.
limits: Historical prose inside the PR can lag actual issue publication/draft metadata. Child issue evidence takes precedence for ticket existence.

title: D7 semantic catalog
observation: Flat v1 composition, fixed families and semantic catalog; bounded containers require a separately ratified successor.
limits: This package proposes that successor, not a claim that it was already ratified.

title: D12 acknowledged drafts and leases
observation: One working revision per exact resource, session-owned fenced lease, CAS, idempotent save receipts and restore-as-new-draft.
limits: Retain its separate resource axes and no persistent offline/CRDT launch posture.

title: D13 scheduled publication
observation: One-time exact-revision appointments; six-day handoff horizon; Inngest executor; current semantic proof at execution.
limits: Routine initiator offboarding is not equivalent to revoking an organization-owned appointment.

title: D30 identity and Payload boundaries
observation: Supabase human identity and Phase 12 capability authority; private Payload; distinct actor/service ports.
limits: No raw-admin or provider fallback; exact transaction adapter still needs real qualification.

title: Merged workflow-orchestration contract
observation: Shared dispatch ledger, product claims, identifier-only events, tenant-scoped execution; orchestrator does not own product facts.
limits: Use the existing runtime rather than a new workflow product.

title: Data access boundary
observation: Business/data logic in packages/api with explicit admin-local Payload exception; browser collections are not multi-table command writers.
limits: Keep Payload runtime in admin and inject the private adapter; do not move it into donor/missionary packages.

title: OpenSpec workflow
observation: Read current context; use the repository-pinned CLI; align proposal/spec/design/tasks; archive only after implementation becomes accepted reality.
limits: The repository CLI was not run by this research task.

title: OpenSpec schema configuration
observation: spec-driven schema, observable scenarios, unique hierarchical task IDs, explicit authority conflicts.
limits: This is a draft change package, not an applied or archived change.

title: Package qualification ticket 1365
observation: Existing package qualification owner; source/manifest, compatibility, dependency and safety proof.
limits: Prior-turn inspected source; refresh the live ticket and blockers at adoption. No duplicate epic is authorized.

title: All-or-none presentation activation ticket 1367
observation: Exact locale cohort, expected heads and design-only activation; previous-design restore creates a successor.
limits: Open and blocked when checked; not implemented merely because ticket exists.

title: Presentation Package D9
observation: Reviewed first-party admission, serialized public view model, narrow capability islands and no runtime tenant-code upload.
limits: Ministry-controlled authorship is an explicit narrow amendment; admission is not automatically waived.

title: Whole-site preview D25
observation: Existing complete immutable private preview contract, referenced by Phase 23 PR and ticket sources.
limits: Referenced owner contract; exact file must be reread before implementation; do not invent a second preview authority.

title: Payload Local API access control
observation: Local API skips access checks by default; actor calls explicitly supply context and overrideAccess:false.
limits: Public documentation is not proof of the internal v4 pin; verify exact cohort.

title: Payload database transactions
observation: Payload propagates transaction identity through req; unawaited transaction work can produce incorrect success responses.
limits: A separate Supabase request is not proven to share the transaction. Qualify one real commit boundary.

title: Payload versions
observation: Versions, drafts and autosave are available persistence/editorial primitives.
limits: They do not implement Asym release/lease policy by themselves.

title: Payload server live preview
observation: Server-rendered preview can refresh on saved changes via a preview bridge.
limits: Preview transport is not publication or authorization.

title: Payload enterprise visual editor
observation: Page still displays Coming Soon in retrieved current documentation.
limits: No enterprise feature dependency is admitted.

title: Payload current stable release API
observation: Endpoint returned v3.89.0, published 2026-09-10; notes include access-default changes for Jobs.
limits: This does not establish that no public v4 prerelease exists. No supported v4 cohort has been qualified here.

title: Puck current release API
observation: Endpoint returned v0.23.0, published 2026-08-07, including outline and Dictionary API improvements.
limits: Qualification candidate only; no exact Core interoperability claim.

title: Puck license
observation: MIT core license inspected.
limits: Verify license and transitive notices at the admitted tag; Puck Cloud/AI is not included by implication.

title: Puck composition API
observation: Composable Preview, Fields, Outline and Components support custom editor layouts.
limits: Cross-origin splitting of its React context is not promised; the proposed whole-composer embedding needs qualification.

title: Puck UI overrides
observation: Overrides are explicitly marked highly experimental.
limits: Prefer composition/custom fields and confine any required override to one adapter.

title: Puck slots and layouts
observation: Slots support nested component composition; current guidance replaces legacy DropZones.
limits: Asym server grammar, not Puck feature breadth, controls allowed layouts.

title: Puck server components
observation: Server rendering and client editor configuration are separate concerns.
limits: Do not move server-only data access into client config or force all public rendering to CSR.

title: Puck permissions
observation: Permissions toggle editor capabilities such as insertion, deletion and movement.
limits: These are UI controls, not evidence of backend authorization.

title: Puck external data
observation: An external selection can load data once and persist it in the editor payload.
limits: Do not copy operational records; use owner-issued references and qualified public projections.

title: Puck viewports
observation: Resizable preview uses a same-origin iframe.
limits: That is not an isolation boundary from the parent composer.

title: Puck data migration
observation: Changing component props can require migration of saved documents.
limits: Library migrations do not decide Asym content semantics or restore policy.

title: GitHub App setup URL
observation: Callback installation_id may be spoofed and requires verified authorization.
limits: A GitHub principal is not an Asym permission grant.

title: GitHub installation tokens
observation: Installation tokens can be narrowed to repositories/permissions and expire after one hour; format is changing.
limits: Treat tokens as opaque secrets, never fixed-length strings or browser authority.

title: GitHub webhook validation
observation: Validate HMAC-SHA256 over the unchanged body with a timing-safe comparison.
limits: Authentication does not replace app-side scope and event-action validation.

title: GitHub webhook best practices
observation: Respond within ten seconds, subscribe narrowly, and use delivery identities for duplicate handling.
limits: Durably accept before success; perform builds out of the request.

title: GitHub missed deliveries
observation: Failed webhooks are not automatically redelivered.
limits: Webhook-only convergence is inadequate; use bounded reconciliation.

title: GitHub Actions secure use
observation: Untrusted source and action/workflow execution require restricted tokens, secret isolation and careful event selection.
limits: Tenant-editable CI cannot be the sole admission oracle.

title: Inngest idempotency
observation: Event ID deduplication is limited to a 24-hour period; application operations should themselves be idempotent.
limits: Product receipts and work claims must survive provider dedupe windows.

title: Inngest concurrency
observation: Supports keyed limits for active step execution.
limits: Not a database lock, tenant permission, or whole-run capacity guarantee.

title: Inngest cancellation
observation: Provides cancellation APIs for function runs.
limits: Cancellation does not undo committed product effects; fenced workers must recheck before commit.

title: Storyblok visual bridge
observation: Draft block identities and editing metadata connect rendered elements to editor fields.
limits: Use the principle, not its floating CDN script or access-token examples as Asym policy.

title: Sanity visual overlays
observation: Source mappings support contextual click-to-edit.
limits: Mappings are not authorization and must be absent from ordinary public output where private.

title: Builder custom components
observation: Developer-defined components register editable inputs for visual authoring.
limits: Does not make arbitrary source round-trip automatically.

title: Craft project configuration
observation: Content configuration can travel through source control separately from editorial content.
limits: Do not synchronize production content by copying a development database.

title: W3C dragging movements
observation: Dragging functionality needs a single-pointer alternative unless essential; keyboard accessibility is also separately necessary.
limits: Move buttons must support pointer and keyboard, not only keyboard shortcuts.

title: postMessage security
observation: Verify origin and source and specify target origin; cross-origin messaging does not itself validate data or authority.
limits: No wildcard bridge or messages that directly publish.

title: PostgreSQL RLS
observation: Existing-row and new-row checks differ; privileged roles can bypass RLS.
limits: Test USING and WITH CHECK, grants and privileged paths under actual deployment roles.

title: TanStack Highlight scope
observation: Read-only highlighting is not incremental code editing or an editor-grade language service.
limits: Optional excerpts only, not IDE or runtime code execution.
